comparison_policy.C_role: Current C implementation is a comparison implementation, not a protocol oracle.
comparison_policy.independent_checks: Rust fixed vectors, malformed-input checks, budgets, and round trips
comparison_policy.canonicality: CER claims cover listed vectors only. Bit counts cover full TLVs. IA5 BER preserves bytes; CER enforces its 7-bit alphabet. Collection SET OF order compares complete child encodings.
